select wa.logistics_bill_id logisticsBillId, ca.status, ca.report_period_id reportPeriodId, sca.bill_source_type billSourceType, scad.end_period_transit_cost endPeriodTransitCost, max(rpm.month) latestMonth from first_mile_weight_allocation wa left join first_mile_cost_allocation ca on wa.logistics_bill_id = ca.logistics_bill_id and ca.is_deleted = false left join report_period_month rpm on ca.report_period_id = rpm.id and rpm.is_deleted = false left join first_mile_sku_cost_allocation sca on sca.main_id = ca.id and sca.is_deleted = false left join first_mile_sku_cost_allocation_detail scad on scad.cost_main_id = sca.id and scad.is_deleted = false
wa.is_deleted = false and wa.logistics_bill_id in
